title: Limitation clause, without doctrine — three transparent layers (clause text, contour, categories) slide apart; plain lines tie each clause line to its categories and a bead traces one category
titleEs: Limitación contractual — Mecanismo o relación explicada
description: An exploded stack: three registered transparent sheets slide apart along a diagonal rail — layer 1 with the supplied clause lines, layer 2 with the contour on clear acetate (a bay round each exclusion to be reviewed), layer 3 with the supplied category tiles. Only the supplied relations are drawn, as plain lines without arrows, from each clause line to the categories read from it. A bead then travels the traversal order for one category and the focus element enlarges. Hold: each tile shows its supplied status (● / ◆ drawn alike) and the key "As supplied · no conclusion drawn". No enforceability, validity, cap or amount.

locale.description: Language of built-in labels (en or es). User-supplied text is never translated.

theme.description: Render treatment. Only tested themes are listed.

palette.description: Colour palette applied to props, actors and accents.

background.description: transparent, paper, white, light-grey, charcoal or a #rrggbb colour.

safeArea.description: Caption-safe margins as fractions of the frame.

reducedMotion.description: Removes decorative motion (overshoot, idle sway, camera drift) while keeping instructional motion.

textVisibility.description: all labels, key labels only, or none (the action must remain readable without labels).

jurisdiction.description: Descriptive jurisdiction tag. "unspecified" means no legal system is asserted.

title.description: Heading of the contract, as supplied (generic, e.g. "Contract (fictional)")

clauseTitle.description: Heading of the clause, as supplied (e.g. "Limitation clause")

clauses.description: Lines of the supplied clause text (generic, fictional placeholders such as "Clause 9.1 (supplied text)"; never real contract text, never an amount) (array replaces the previous value)

label.description: Label of the category, as supplied (generic, fictional)

status.description: Supplied status: included or review (exclusion to be reviewed)

clause.description: The supplied clause line this category is read from (1 = first; clamped to the list)

categories.description: Categories of liability named by the supplied text, top to bottom. Each has a supplied status: "included" (inside the contour) or "review" (an exclusion to be reviewed: the contour forms a bay around it). Nothing is inferred from either status (array replaces the previous value)

review.description: Status "exclusion to be reviewed", as supplied

statusLabels.description: Wording of the two supplied statuses (equal weight: ● included, ◆ to be reviewed)

focusCategory.description: The category the bead traces (1 = top; clamped to the list)

focusElement.description: Element the bead dwells on longest (it enlarges while the bead rests on it)

traversalOrder.description: Order in which the bead visits the elements (array replaces the previous value)

target.description: Scene element the annotation points at

items.description: Editorial annotation shown during the hold

annotations.description: Editorial callouts shown in the final hold (array replaces the previous value)
